notes: Curated snapshot for the hybrid calibration path. Keyed by YYYYMM. Annual means are computed by consumers, never stored as month keys.

provenance.source: NASA POWER API v2.10.0 (power.larc.nasa.gov), monthly point query
provenance.retrieval_note: Values re-fetched from the live API on 2026-10-06 and checked field by field against this snapshot; all agree to the stored precision.
provenance.annual_mean_note: The API also returns an annual mean under the YYYY13 key (ALLSKY 5.209, CLRSKY 6.457 kWh/m^2/day). That key was removed from this snapshot because it is an annual aggregate, not a thirteenth month; consumers compute their own mean from the twelve monthly keys.
provenance.august_note: August GHI of 5.74 kWh/m^2/day is the genuine NASA POWER value for 2023-08, sitting between two genuinely lower monsoon months. It is not an error and must not be 'corrected'.
provenance.elevation_note: elevation_m 540.94 is returned by the API as the point's z coordinate.
